about: A sample of the chip sheet R33 writes as lab/refine/research/kernels/data/chipsheet-<gfx>-<date>.json. It documents the fields lab/placement.py reads (placement_reads below); the placement reader ignores every other field, so the real sheet may carry any more. A value is a number or an object whose 'value' is the number, with the command, the repeats and the spread beside it. In this sample the memory and power values are hour-0 facts and earlier measurements on the same chip, each with its source; bandwidth and matmul rate are null because nothing has measured them yet (R33 does). The placement plan marks every number it takes from a sheet with sample: true as a sample, never as a measurement.

placement_reads.memory.visible_gib: GiB of device memory torch reports (torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory / 2**30); the teacher's vLLM share is a fraction of this
placement_reads.memory.free_gib: GiB a new job can still take with nothing of ours running: torch.cuda.mem_get_info()[0] / 2**30 and MemAvailable, the smaller, since the APU's GPU memory is the host's RAM
placement_reads.bandwidth.copy_d2d_peak_gb_s: the best achieved device-to-device copy bandwidth over the sizes in bandwidth.copy_d2d, GB/s (a list of {bytes, gb_s, repeats, spread_pct} rows is read when the peak is absent)
placement_reads.matmul.bf16_peak_tflops: the best achieved bf16 matmul rate over the shapes in matmul.shapes, TFLOPS (a list of {use, dtype, m, n, k, tflops, repeats, spread_pct} rows is read when the peak is absent)
placement_reads.power.idle_w: amd-smi SOCKET_POWER with nothing running, W (the whole APU package)
placement_reads.power.loaded_w: amd-smi SOCKET_POWER averaged over the loaded measurements, W

versions.source: R30 task page, hour-0 facts of pod D, line of Sat 5:40 PM ET (https://app.notion.com/p/3f596ef5fec58118b653e4f3ae2d3024)

visible_gib.command: torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory / 2**30 (the torch_gpu line of bash lab/pod_a_teacher.sh facts)
visible_gib.source: R30 task page, hour-0 facts of pod D: 64.0 GiB visible to torch, 1 device

free_gib.command: MemAvailable in /proc/meminfo / 2**20 (the mem line of bash lab/pod_a_teacher.sh facts); torch.cuda.mem_get_info() was not read
free_gib.source: R30 task page, hour-0 facts of pod D: 62 GB RAM, 58 GB available

copy_d2d_peak_gb_s.source: not measured yet: R33 measures device-to-device copies from 1 MB to 4 GB

bf16_peak_tflops.source: not measured yet: R33 measures the 27B decode and 4B LoRA step shapes

idle_w.command: amd-smi metric --power, SOCKET_POWER, ten reads one second apart: 19 12 10 9 9 9 9 8 9 9
idle_w.source: R30 task page, hour-0 facts of pod D (the settled reads)

loaded_w.command: amd-smi metric --power, SOCKET_POWER, over the decode window of one teacher request
loaded_w.source: lab/refine/metrics.jsonl:29 (teacher.watts_avg, pod C, the same chip, text decode)
